header.title: Fundamentos de cibersegurança
header.subtitle: Build a Strong Security Foundation for Your Organisation
header.description: Protect your business with essential cybersecurity training and implementation. From SIEM solutions and threat detection to compliance frameworks and staff awareness, we help you establish robust security practices from the ground up.

overview.title: Service Overview
overview.content: Our Cybersecurity Fundamentals service provides organisations with the essential building blocks of a strong security posture. We deliver hands-on training, implement core security technologies, and help you achieve compliance with industry standards including ISO 27001, GDPR, and SOC2. Whether you are a startup building security from scratch or an established business strengthening your defences, our team ensures you have the knowledge and tools to protect what matters most.

features.title: Security Assessment
features.description: Thorough evaluation of your current security posture, identifying gaps, risks, and areas for immediate improvement.

features.title: Vulnerability Scanning
features.description: Automated and manual vulnerability scanning across your infrastructure, applications, and networks to identify exploitable weaknesses.

features.title: Policy Development
features.description: Creation of comprehensive security policies, procedures, and guidelines aligned with industry best practices and compliance requirements.

features.title: Staff Training
features.description: Interactive cybersecurity awareness training for all staff levels, covering phishing, social engineering, password hygiene, and data handling.

features.title: Monitoring Setup
features.description: Implementation of SIEM solutions and monitoring tools to provide real-time visibility into security events and potential threats.

features.title: Compliance Support
features.description: Guidance and implementation support for achieving ISO 27001, GDPR, and SOC2 compliance certifications.

pricing.title: Preços
pricing.description: Engagements starting from £1,500. Tailored to your organisation's size and requirements.

steps.title: Initial Assessment
steps.description: We evaluate your current security posture, infrastructure, and compliance status to establish a clear baseline.

steps.title: Risk Analysis
steps.description: We identify and prioritise risks, vulnerabilities, and threats specific to your organisation and industry.

steps.title: Implementação
steps.description: We deploy security tools, configure monitoring systems, and establish policies and procedures tailored to your needs.

steps.title: Training & Awareness
steps.description: We deliver comprehensive training to your staff, building a security-conscious culture across the organisation.

steps.title: Review & Certification
steps.description: We conduct final reviews, prepare compliance documentation, and support you through certification processes.
